verdict.rationale: telli's docs describe Charlie, a built-in AI assistant that can 'build and refine agents' and 'automate workflows', and its MCP server exposes Charlie to external AI tools. That covers the core idea of platform-native AI helping to author agents and flows, but only as one-line claims with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documented generation or improvement of prompts from a natural-language description, AI-generated test cases, details of how Charlie edits flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
